tasks.short: Select and obtain teaching materials and supplies

steps.what: Determine actual communications-course material and supply requirements
inputs: actual course outcomes and enrolment
existing textbook and teaching-supply requirements

steps.what: Inspect available textbooks and supplies, approved catalogue terms and existing stock
inputs: checked teaching material needs
existing approved catalogue and actual stock records
outputs: checked available options, quantities and terms

steps.what: Select textbooks and supplies for actual pedagogical suitability, accessibility and budget constraints
inputs: checked available options, quantities and terms
checked teaching material needs
actual material samples and accessibility information
outputs: human-selected materials and actual selection rationale

steps.what: Prepare the acquisition requisition with actual selected items, quantities and approved purchasing destination
inputs: human-selected materials and actual selection rationale
checked available options, quantities and terms
existing course and cost-centre identifiers
verified internal purchasing recipient
outputs: complete acquisition requisition with exact items, quantities, costs and recipient

steps.what: Approve the completed requisition against actual selections and purchasing authority
inputs: complete acquisition requisition with exact items, quantities, costs and recipient
outputs: approved final teacher requisition and internal recipient

steps.what: Submit the approved acquisition requisition to internal purchasing
inputs: approved final teacher requisition and internal recipient

steps.what: Check actual delivered materials or digital access against the selected items
inputs: actual delivered textbooks, supplies or digital access
human-selected materials and actual selection rationale

steps.what: Capture actual receipt, access and any delivery discrepancy
inputs: actual receipt and suitability findings

steps.what: Approve the completed actual receipt record
inputs: complete actual receipt record draft

steps.what: Save the approved actual material receipt record
inputs: approved final actual receipt record

tasks.design: Configure catalogue/stock views and reusable course requisition fields in {PROCUREMENT}, using {LMS} for existing teaching access. The teacher selects suitable material, approves the complete internal request and checks actual receipt after purchasing fulfils it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inspecting available options and preparing repeated requisition fields can surround pedagogical selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters and request forms can reuse verified items and course identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Textbook quality, accessibility and whether actual delivery meets teaching needs require the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises whether material teaches the intended communications skill rather than merely matching a catalogue keyword.

ambition.what: Keep teaching material choices human while reducing limited acquisition administration.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for catalogue, budget and course permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: institutional purchasing systems can show approved catalogues and stock and populate requisition fields from selected items.

assumptions: Provisional scenario arithmetic, not observed teacher purchasing effort.
Actual catalogue and stock records already exist; missing prices, licence terms or stock confirmation must be obtained and counted.
s3 counts actual selection and s4 captures actual requested quantities. Purchasing performs its own authorised order and fulfilment work; no saving is claimed for that role.
Actual receipt is checked and captured only after delivery in s7 and s8. Native configuration first; send and same-system save have no saving.
unknowns: Availability of accurate stock and accessibility information
research_questions: Which requisition fields can reuse existing verified catalogue values?

incremental.description: Maintain course requisition defaults and catalogue links

approvals.approved_version: approved exact teacher requisition and internal recipient; changes return to s5
approved final actual receipt record; changes return to s9

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 8 catalogue-view hours +8 requisition-preparation hours =16. Two upkeep hours give central net 14%; four extra hours checking incomplete catalogue terms gives high 10%. Low zero where native features already cover this.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Read current committee papers on institutional policies, departmental matters and academic issues
inputs: actual current agenda, policy papers and prior decision records

steps.what: Serve on the committee by debating actual issues, judging options and contributing to decisions
inputs: checked committee brief and questions
members' actual views and evidence
outputs: actual committee contributions and agreed or unresolved actions

steps.what: Capture the teacher's actual committee actions, positions and unresolved questions
inputs: actual committee contributions and agreed or unresolved actions
outputs: complete personal committee action record draft

steps.what: Prepare the teacher's internal follow-up message using actual recorded actions and verified colleagues
inputs: complete personal committee action record draft
verified internal colleague recipients
outputs: complete internal committee follow-up and recipients

steps.what: Approve the completed personal record and exact internal follow-up message
inputs: complete personal committee action record draft
complete internal committee follow-up and recipients
outputs: approved final committee record and exact follow-up

steps.what: Send the approved exact follow-up to the internal committee colleagues
inputs: approved final committee record and exact follow-up

steps.what: Save the approved personal committee action record
inputs: approved final committee record and exact follow-up

tasks.design: Configure current committee paper links in {DOCS} and a native follow-up template in {EMAIL}. The teacher reads substantive issues, contributes to decisions and captures actual personal actions; completed records and messages are approved before separate save and send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating current committee papers and formatting follow-up can repeat work around committee participation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioned paper indexes and message templates can reuse actual records.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional trade-offs, policy judgement and persuasion require committee members.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher brings discipline-specific teaching experience to decisions affecting academic work.

ambition.what: Make committee preparation and actual follow-up easier to manage.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for committee paper access and secretariat agreement

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: shared document indexes and email templates can reduce repeated committee-paper retrieval and follow-up formatting.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured committee baselines.
The secretariat supplies actual agenda and papers. s3 counts the teacher's actual personal action capture; official minutes remain the secretariat's separate responsibility.
Native links and templates first. No model decides policy or infers agreement from discussion.
Internal transmission and same-system save are fully retained with no saving.
research_questions: Does current version indexing already remove repetitive paper retrieval?

already_counted.description: Check completed personal record and exact follow-up

incremental.description: Maintain paper links and follow-up template fields

approvals.approved_version: approved exact internal follow-up and recipients; changes return to s5
approved final personal committee record from s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 10 paper-retrieval hours +4 follow-up assembly hours =14. Two upkeep hours give central net 12%; three extra hours resolving paper revisions gives high 9%. Low zero with current native coverage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain office hours and advise students

steps.what: Prepare regularly scheduled office-hour availability against actual teaching and appointment commitments
inputs: actual teaching and appointment calendar
teacher's chosen office-hour pattern and course access rules
outputs: complete proposed office-hour availability and exact student audience

steps.what: Approve the completed office-hour availability, access conditions and student audience
inputs: complete proposed office-hour availability and exact student audience
outputs: approved final office-hour schedule and audience

steps.what: Publish the exact approved office-hour availability to the authorised student audience
inputs: approved final office-hour schedule and audience

steps.what: Read permitted actual course and student information relevant to the advising question
inputs: student's actual stated question
existing permitted course and student records
outputs: checked advising context and unanswered questions

steps.what: Hold office hours to advise and assist actual students and clarify their needs
inputs: checked advising context and unanswered questions
student's actual concerns and responses
outputs: actual advice, student responses and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Capture the permitted actual advising outcome and follow-up without recording unnecessary personal detail
inputs: actual advice, student responses and agreed follow-up
institutional advising record rules

steps.what: Approve the completed actual advising note against the conversation and permitted record scope
inputs: complete actual advising note draft

steps.what: Save the approved actual advising note
inputs: approved final actual advising note

tasks.design: Configure conflict views and reusable availability in {CALENDAR}, and a permitted advising context view in {LMS}. The teacher approves the complete office-hour schedule before publication, advises actual students and records actual outcomes separately after the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing availability and finding relevant course context can take time around office-hour advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar conflict views and course-record filters can reuse existing commitments and permitted information.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding an individual student's needs and choosing appropriate advice requires the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises uncertainty or personal context that a booking or course record cannot explain.

ambition.what: Keep office-hour administration manageable while preserving direct student advice.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–4 for student-record access and advising-policy review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: calendars can display commitment conflicts and course systems can show permitted advising context without replacing student conversations.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured office-hour baselines.
Actual commitments and permitted course records already exist; missing student context is clarified in s5.
s1 prepares availability rather than silently creating future student bookings. s3 is the explicit publication action.
The teacher captures actual advice in s6. Native views are checked first; no saving in the conversation, actual note capture, publication or same-system save.
research_questions: Which availability preparation and context retrieval remains repetitive after native configuration?

incremental.description: Maintain availability settings and permitted course context views

approvals.approved_version: approved exact office-hour schedule and student audience; changes return to s2
approved final actual advising note; changes return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 6 availability-preparation hours +6 context-retrieval hours =12. One upkeep hour gives central net 11%; three additional hours resolving calendar exceptions gives high 8%. Low zero with current native coverage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform department-head and related administrative duties

steps.what: Review actual department teaching commitments, deadlines and current administrative issues
inputs: existing actual department commitments and course records
current recorded administrative issues
outputs: checked department status and unresolved matters

steps.what: Discuss actual departmental matters with faculty and administrative colleagues
inputs: checked department status and unresolved matters
colleagues' actual constraints and views

steps.what: Review actual department budget and resource commitments relevant to administrative decisions
inputs: actual approved department budget and posted commitments
current resource requests

steps.what: Make authorised department administrative decisions and determine accountable owners and conditions
inputs: actual departmental discussion outcomes
checked financial and resource constraints
actual departmental authority rules
outputs: human-chosen decisions, owners and unresolved conditions

steps.what: Prepare the actual decision record and colleague message using structured department fields
inputs: human-chosen decisions, owners and unresolved conditions
existing department and course identifiers
verified internal colleague recipients
outputs: complete department decision record and exact colleague message

steps.what: Approve the completed decision record and exact colleague message, owners and conditions
inputs: complete department decision record and exact colleague message
human-chosen decisions, owners and unresolved conditions
outputs: approved final department record and colleague message

steps.what: Send the approved exact department message to its internal colleague recipients
inputs: approved final department record and colleague message

steps.what: Save the approved department decision record
inputs: approved final department record and colleague message

tasks.design: Configure department status views in {PROJECT} and budget views in {ERP}, with reusable decision-record fields and a message template in {EMAIL}. The teacher discusses actual issues, makes authorised decisions and captures actual owners and conditions before approving the complete record and message.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated status, budget and record-field preparation can consume time around department administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native administrative views and templates can reuse existing course and department identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Academic priorities, personnel concerns and conflicting commitments require accountable department leadership.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands teaching consequences and can explain an administrative decision to affected colleagues.

ambition.what: Review unresolved department commitments with current resource evidence.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for departmental finance access and faculty/staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project and finance systems can provide department status views and structured decision records with reusable message fields.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional work-design inputs, not measured department-head baselines.
Actual commitments and budgets already exist in source systems; absent updates must be obtained and counted.
s5 retains actual decision and owner capture; only repeated identifier fields and message layout change.
Native configuration first. No model decides staff or academic matters. The internal send and same-system save have no saving.
Department administration overlaps with committee and material-acquisition tasks; reconcile those boundaries before adding role savings.
research_questions: Which preparation work remains repetitive after native department views and templates?

already_counted.description: Check complete department record and exact colleague message

incremental.description: Maintain department views, source links and decision templates

approvals.approved_version: approved exact department message and internal recipients; changes return to s6
approved final department decision record from s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 8 status-view hours +6 budget-view hours +3 repeated-field hours =17. Two upkeep hours give central net 15%; four additional hours resolving stale commitments gives high 11%. Low zero if current native views already cover this work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: A communications teacher with less routine preparation and administration, retaining academic decisions, teaching-material judgement and direct student support.
